notablePrerequisites: Leyline Immersion attached to a legendary creature you control without summoning sickness.
description:
Activate the creature with Leyline Immersion attached by tapping it, adding {3}{U}{U} that can only be spent to cast spells.
Cast Mind Games with buyback by paying {2}{U}{U}, targeting Chakram Retriever.
Chakram Retriever triggers, causing you to untap the creature with Leyline Immersion attached.
Resolve Mind Games, tapping Chakram Retriever and returning Mind Games to your hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use Chakram Retriever's ability to untap any other creature(s) you control.
